description: The bar chart illustrates model accuracy results (in percent) across three evaluation categories, showing multiple methods and their self-reflection variants side by side within each category. The horizontal axis contains the categories “Mathverse,” “MMLU,” and “Physics,” arranged left to right, and the vertical axis is labeled “Accuracy (%)” on a linear scale spanning roughly 50 to 62 with evenly spaced tick marks at 2-point intervals. For each category, six adjacent bars are shown corresponding to the legend: DAPO (light blue with diagonal hatching), DAPO+Self-reflection (solid blue), SRPO (solid orange), PPO (teal with diagonal hatching), PPO+Self-reflection (solid green), and PPO (orange with diagonal hatching; as labeled in the legend). In Mathverse, the bars are approximately DAPO ≈53.1, DAPO+Self-reflection ≈56.1, SRPO ≈55.8, PPO (orange hatched) ≈53.4, PPO (teal hatched) ≈53.3, and PPO+Self-reflection ≈54.5. In MMLU, the bars are approximately DAPO ≈55.9, DAPO+Self-reflection ≈56.9, SRPO ≈57.1, PPO (orange hatched) ≈55.8, PPO (teal hatched) ≈54.6, and PPO+Self-reflection ≈56.2. In Physics, the bars are approximately DAPO ≈57.5, DAPO+Self-reflection ≈61.0, SRPO ≈60.6, PPO (orange hatched) ≈58.1, PPO (teal hatched) ≈56.9, and PPO+Self-reflection ≈59.1. The bars are grouped by category rather than sorted by value, and no individual bars appear specially emphasized beyond the use of distinct colors and hatch patterns indicated by the legend.
